<thought>Since the strict search returned no templates, I will broaden the query by removing the bond criteria and only filtering by the functional groups that are broken (ketones, aromatic hydroxyls) and formed (ether oxygens). This should retrieve templates that match the overall transformation.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1C(C2=CC=CC=C2)C3=CC=CC=C3O1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "aromatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
